headline: Expanse and Nevish Lines Shift; Kuura Strand Fighting Eases
war_summary: The hottest ground of the past day has cooled. Kuura Strand, where the sharpest fighting of the last report was logged, now shows four actions in two hours and eighteen in six against thirty-five across the full day, with hourly casualties down to six Colonial and four Warden, a small fraction of the day's totals of 3,604 and 3,208. Its lines stand at five Colonial works to one Warden, Faden Point and Menneen the busiest points of contact. Weathered Expanse remains the war's great grinder: sixty-one actions in a day at a cost of 8,330 Colonial and 8,984 Warden, and its ground has reversed since the afternoon edition, reading two Warden works, five Colonial and two unclaimed, with Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch bearing the brunt. On the Nevish Line the Colonials have added a work; the line now stands five Warden to three Colonial, Tomb Father most heavily engaged. Marban Hollow is split four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed, its action centred on Checkpoint Bua. Linn Mercy, Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf keep up costly pressure, though Linn Mercy has gone quiet since midday. Callahan's Passage, Dead Lands and Farranac Coast remain costly but largely static.
